verdict: M46.7 COMPLETE. Test suite has volume (2907 tests passing) but low parametrization (7) and weak branch discrimination (6.72%). Many services/repositories are essentially untested. The test suite proves 'code executed' for many modules, not 'behavior is correct'. This motivates M46.14 (services + repositories convergence) and M46.13 (strengthening validation).
